title: Crossing the ceiling stops new computer work, not the whole organization
description:
**Phase 4 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the ceiling story
- **Runs in parallel with:** the alert story and the display story
- **Unblocks:** nothing

---
The design constraint that matters most in this epic.

A member who cannot read their own channels because a budget tripped will conclude the product broke, not that they hit a limit they set. Locking the workplace over spend is the same customer experience as an outage, and it destroys the trust the ceiling was meant to protect.

So the ceiling stops the thing that costs money — new computer work — and leaves everything else reachable, including the message explaining what happened and how to raise it. This is the authorization_ceiling seam, which already refuses actions rather than removing access.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text:
Feature: Organization spend ceiling

  Scenario: New computer work is refused past the ceiling
    Given an enabled organization whose month-to-date spend has passed its ceiling
    When a member asks a bot for work that needs the computer
    Then the request is refused with a spend ceiling reason
    And no computer is started

  Scenario: The workplace stays reachable past the ceiling
    Given an enabled organization whose month-to-date spend has passed its ceiling
    When a member opens the workspace
    Then they read their channels and see why work is paused
    And the organization status is still enabled

  Scenario: Raising the ceiling resumes work
    Given an organization whose work is paused at its spend ceiling
    When its owner raises the ceiling above current spend
    Then computer work is accepted again

Composer 2.5 product review **REQUEST CHANGES** on [#338](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chatticus/pull/338). Do not merge.

1. `ComputerWorker._dispatch_host_start_if_needed`: `OrganizationSpendCeilingExceededError` is raised from `request_computer_host_start`, outside the `try` around `start_host`. Uncaught → Lambda batch failure. Mapping it to `ComputerWorkerHostNotReady` would SQS-nack forever. Fail the turn visibly (mirror computerless denial). No host start.

2. Fail-closed meter (`ce_status=pending`/`error`, even when MTD is under the ceiling) is pytest-only. Add Gherkin: refuse computer work and surface `computer_work_paused` + meter-unavailable reason on GET `/me`.

Public `ControlPlane` wrapper instead of `plane._messaging_store` in `principal.py` if you touch that file. Worktree stays `/tmp/chatticus-6a9e97-ceiling-stop`.
